snippet.title: Inquisitor Shepherd - Demo trailer
snippet.description:
Become Shepherd, an inquisitor sent to a suspicious village.
Unveil the secrets of a world filled with fear, and make an inevitable choice. In this visual novel mystery, your decisions change the world.
Can you survive the desperate horror?

🔽 Play demo now 🔽
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963700/Inquisitor_Shepherd_Demo/?l=english
